title: Project Rehab (Chopped LS Swapped 80 Series)
ai_summary: Chopped 1994 80-series Land Cruiser (ute conversion) rebuilt around a built LQ4 6.0L Gen III LS V8 (BTR Stage 2 cam, Wiseco pistons, LS7 lifters, head studs, upgraded oiling) paired to a 4L80E automatic and a Mark's 4WD adapter/transfer-case kit. No dyno figures were published in the opening posts, which focus mainly on parts acquisition and build planning.

complications.detail: Fitted an Alloy Works 3-row radiator with electric fans plus separate transmission and power steering coolers
Used a PSI wiring harness with a Cruiser Matt drive-by-wire delete plug
Required Selkirk off-road motor mounts, a custom crossmember, and a Mark's 4WD oil pan/sump pickup kit
